notes.title: Linux Update
notes.content:
We've just released a new version of the game that includes the following changes:
[list]
[*] New Linux version with significantly improved performance
[*] Reduced file size of the game for all platforms
[*] Other small fixes and improvements
[/list]

Enjoy grappling with even more frames!
If you have any feedback or questions be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/NMYxQxs]Join Our Discord™[/url]

notes.title: New Update: Unlockable Skins
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce a free update to Get-A-Grip Chip adding unlockable skins.

Discover and unlock 8 new skins for Chip by completing various challenges throughout the game. 
For the veteran players, this includes one skin that will remove all checkpoints, requiring you to beat each level in a single try!

notes.title: Lunar Sale On Now + Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Get-A-Grip Chip is taking part in the Steam Lunar Sale, and there's never been a better time to pick up a copy! We've been hard at work updating the game and we're very excited to announce that a free update will be coming to Steam on March 25, 2021. 

Alongside a number of improvements and adjustments, this update adds brand new unlockable skins or  "equipment" that can be obtained by rescuing Battery Bots, and completing other challenges. See if you can get them all!

notes.title: Livestream: Autumn Sale and Update
notes.content:
How is everyone doing out there?
Here at Redstart we're hunkering down and getting to work so we can keep delivering you great content as we prepare for winter. Steam is also preparing for winter and the holiday season by running the Autumn Sale where you can grab Get-A-Grip Chip, the soundtrack or the game + soundtrack bundle at 20% off! Check it out here today!

In addition to some bug fixes and performance improvements added to the newest build, we have some updates coming in December that are bound to knock your wool socks off (and knowing wool socks, it takes quite a bit to send them flying)! Keep your eyes peeled on our social media accounts and our Discord for an announcement next month!

In the unlikely event that you don't know how you got here:
In Get-A-Grip Chip, you play as Chip and use his handy-dandy grapple claw to zip through the air. Blast your way through 30 levels of soaring, novel, platforming challenges -- with no jump button!
